Review of hub_depots (request_changes): The implementation doesn't strictly adhere to the 'cut to the top_n' requirement in the docstring. Currently, if multiple depots share the same degree as the threshold, you return all of them, which could result in more than `top_n` depots being returned. You should probably just slice the sorted `degrees` list to `[:top_n]` instead of using a threshold-based loop.
